title: REQ · Story panel is a store-driven mobile bottom drawer and legacy layout CSS is removed
summary: Mobile drawer uses useUiStore and Tailwind; legacy .game-layout/.story-panel CSS deleted
description: Context: the drawer flag is local useState and the mobile positioning is in a legacy media query. Desired behavior: GameLayout reads drawerOpen and toggleDrawer from useUiStore, positions the aside as a fixed bottom drawer below md via Tailwind, and keeps scene controls reachable by reserving space for the drawer handle. The legacy layout rules are deleted. Why: the single store owns UI state and the legacy CSS is dead.
acceptance_criteria: Given useUiStore drawerOpen false, when GameLayout renders, then the Story button has aria-expanded false and the aside has data-state closed.
Given the Story button clicked, when the store changes, then useUiStore.getState().drawerOpen is true, aria-expanded is true and the aside has data-state open; a second click returns it to false.
Given the scene slot, when the drawer is closed or open, then the scene content remains in the document and the scene main has bottom padding below md (pb-12) so controls are not covered.
Given src/styles.css, when read, then no .game-layout, .story-panel, .scene-area or max-width media query remains while .contribution-sheet rules remain.
technical_constraints: Toggle button hidden at md and up
definition_of_done: Drawer is store-driven and legacy CSS removed
